title: Shackles Manifest
next_chapter_hook: Chen Ji's roar shook the entire imperial capital. Mo Xiansheng, far away in the Xuanwu Sect, opened his eyes: "This child... has finally begun to walk his own path."

text.content:
Midnight. Inside an abandoned shrine in the northwestern corner of the imperial capital, candlelight flickered. Chen Ji surveyed his surroundings—Su Qingyao stood with hands clasped behind her back by the window, moonlight outlining her cold, serene profile; Ye Qing leaned in the shadows, violet demonic qi coiling around her fingertips; in a corner, a faint shadow flickered in and out of existence—that was the remnant consciousness of Chen Nian.

Seven days. Only seven days remained.

The Tianji Pavilion's countdown hung like a sword overhead, while the Eyes of Heavenly Dao's surveillance never ceased. Chen Ji slowly unfolded the yellowed fragment in his hand—the position of the fifth page of the Tianji Record remained a chaotic, grayish white.

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao turned around, her voice carrying rare gravity: "The conditions of the Tianji Pavilion—I don't believe you're unaware of the price. Becoming their 'eyes,' did you think you could retain any clarity?" Her gaze fell on Chen Ji's face, "Or do you have other plans?"

Ye Qing laughed lightly, that smile carrying a hint of self-mockery: "The Holy Sect treats me as a chess piece, the Tianji Pavilion wants to make you a chess piece—this world's major powers don't see ordinary people as human beings." She raised her hand, demonic qi solidifying into a pitch-black token, "My 'Demonic Path Mist' can temporarily shield the Tianji Record's aura, but this thing... diminishes with each use."

text.content:
Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, then suddenly laughed. That smile carried no warmth; instead, it sent chills down one's spine. He slapped the Tianji Record fragment onto the table, his gaze sweeping across every face present.

"The Tianji Pavilion wants me to be their 'eyes,' and the Eyes of Heavenly Dao want me dead." His voice was soft, yet every word was clear, "Fellows, do you think Chen Ji seems like the type to be someone's chess piece?"

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao's brow furrowed slightly, yet she read a certain resolve in Chen Ji's eyes. She stepped closer, lowering her voice: "What are you planning? The inheritance of the fifth page of the Tianji Record... I've searched through all the classics in the scripture library and found no precedent. Legend says even the founder dared not touch that forbidden realm."

text.content:
"Forbidden realm?" Chen Ji sneered, his fingertips brushing across the grayish-white area on the fragment, "Every step I've taken from废物杂役 to today has been stepping on forbidden realms. The Tianji Pavilion wants me as their watchdog, the Eyes of Heavenly Dao want to crush me to bits—then I'll shatter this chessboard and become the one who holds the pieces."

His tone was flat, as if speaking of something insignificant, but Su Qingyao distinctly felt a chill.

choice.prompt: Chen Ji decided to unlock the fifth page, but the method required careful consideration—this was a high-stakes gamble, and who would bear the cost?

choices.text: Using my Heavenly Fate Value as the guide, forcibly breaking through
choices.description: Using the Tianji Record's own mechanism to counter the Tianji Pavilion's seal, directly burning Chen Ji's Heavenly Fate Value for unlocking. High risk, but may trigger the Tianji Record's instinctive awakening.
choices.visible_reward: Opportunity to trigger Tianji Record's instinctive reaction
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate Value is below 50; forcible breakthrough may cause backlash and loss of control

text.content: Chen Ji said no more. He closed his eyes, and the text on the Tianji Record fragment began to flash wildly. A magnificent power surged from within him—that was the unique golden light of Heavenly Fate Value burning—but this time, threads of black lines were intermingled within the golden light.

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao grabbed Chen Ji's wrist abruptly: "Your Heavenly Fate Value... is draining madly!" She felt that hand was cold as death.

choices.text: Using Ye Qing's demonic qi for cover
choices.description: Having Ye Qing use the Demonic Path Mist to conceal the Tianji Record's aura while attempting to unlock. The collision between demonic qi and heavenly secrets may produce unexpected changes.
choices.visible_cost: Consumes Ye Qing's Demonic Path Mist 3 uses
choices.visible_reward: Unlocking environment is safer, may gain demonic qi bonus
choices.risk_hint: Demonic Path Mist will expose Ye Qing's identity to the Tianji Pavilion

text.content: Ye Qing hesitated not at all. Ink-black demonic qi surged from her palm, instantly enveloping Chen Ji within. That demonic qi intertwined with the Tianji Record's aura, emitting an earsplitting hum.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing's face turned pale, cold sweat beading on her forehead: "The Tianji Pavilion's aura... is more terrifying than I imagined. This thing is surveilling you, more urgently than any of us."

choices.text: Summoning Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul for guidance
choices.description: Requesting Mo Xiansheng, guardian of the first page of the Tianji Record, to assist in unlocking. He is the only one who knows the complete truth of the Tianji Record, but will only reveal what should be said each time.
choices.visible_reward: Unlocking process is more controllable, may gain key information
choices.risk_hint: Mo Xiansheng never helps without compensation; there will certainly be hidden conditions

text.content: Chen Ji dripped a drop of essence blood onto the position of the first page on the fragment. A withered figure abruptly materialized in the void—that was Mo Xiansheng, his remnant soul had faded to near transparency.

dialogue.content: A complex flicker crossed Mo Xiansheng's turbid eyes: "The fifth page... are you certain you wish to walk this path?" His voice was like an echo from antiquity, "The price of that page is not something you alone can bear."

text.content:
The grayish-white on the fragment began to violently oscillate. Chen Ji felt his soul simultaneously locked by two distinctly different forces—one cold and high above, carrying the pressure of Heavenly Will; the other deep and greedy, like countless hands reaching out from the abyss of eternity.

Tearing sensation.

An unprecedented剧痛 spread from his Mental Sea to every limb. Chen Ji let out a grunt, his spine suddenly arching, veins bulging at his temples.

He saw.

Deep within his chaotic consciousness, two eyes opened simultaneously. One was the Eyes of Heavenly Dao, its vertical pupil containing no emotion, only cold scrutiny; the other was the Eyes of the Tianji Pavilion, and it was smiling—smiling sinisterly and triumphantly.

"Ant." That voice came from both eyes simultaneously, "You think you can break free?"

"A tool should have a tool's觉悟."

dialogue.content: Chen Ji!" Su Qingyao's voice seemed to pass through a heavy barrier. She tried to approach but was pushed back by an invisible force. "Your soul... is being eroded by something!"

text.content:
In Chen Ji's Mental Sea, the Eyes of Heavenly Dao and the Eyes of the Tianji Pavilion pressed closer simultaneously. A cold voice reverberated in the depths of his soul: "Every generation of prophets has been a chess piece. The Tianji Record is merely..."

"Merely a cage." The Eyes of the Tianji Pavilion coldly laughed, "You merely wish to break out of one cage and crawl into another."

Chen Ji felt his consciousness on the verge of collapse, but he gritted his teeth, and the corner of his mouth actually formed a smile.

"Cage?" Chen Ji's voice was hoarse, yet carried undeniable power. His soul trembled in extreme pain, yet he did not retreat, instead actively rushing toward those two eyes, "In this life of mine, my destiny is to smash cages."

He suddenly raised his head, his gaze like a blade.

choice.prompt: At the moment his soul was about to be torn apart by the two major forces, Chen Ji must make a crucial choice—compromise to survive, or burn everything to counterattack?

choices.text: Using Heavenly Fate Value as a blade, slashing at the Eyes of Heavenly Dao
choices.description: Concentrating all burning Heavenly Fate Value into an illusory blade, actively slashing toward the eye representing Heavenly Will. This is a declaration of war against Heaven—success or death.
choices.visible_cost: Heavenly Fate Value -50 (may drop to dangerous levels)
choices.visible_reward: May severely wound the Eyes of Heavenly Dao's surveillance, weakening its monitoring
choices.risk_hint: The Eyes of Heavenly Dao is a transcendent existence; direct confrontation carries extremely high risk

text.content: Golden Heavenly Fate Value condensed into an illusory blade in Chen Ji's palm. He swung without hesitation—that blade slashed toward the Eyes of Heavenly Dao's vertical pupil, bringing with it a string of earsplitting wails.

dialogue.content: "Get lost!" Chen Ji's voice exploded like thunder, "My life, I myself decide!" His roar shook the entire imperial capital. Even Mo Xiansheng, far away in the Xuanwu Sect, abruptly opened his eyes.

choices.text: Using demonic qi as a shield, forcibly withstand the dual gazes
choices.description: Borrowing Ye Qing's demonic qi to construct protection within the soul, forcibly enduring the dual erosion, waiting for the Tianji Record's instinctive awakening. Self-rescue rather than counterattack.
choices.visible_cost: Ye Qing's demonic qi heavily consumed
choices.visible_reward: May trigger the Tianji Record's protective mechanism
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing may be exposed as a result, detected by the Tianji Pavilion

text.content: Violet demonic qi surged madly from within Ye Qing, like a barrier wrapping around Chen Ji. The Eyes of the Tianji Pavilion and the Eyes of Heavenly Dao simultaneously struck this barrier, producing a sound like clashing metal.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing's face was ashen, blood trickling from the corner of her mouth, yet she gritted her teeth and persevered: "Chen Ji... I can only hold for thirty breaths!" Her voice was trembling.

text.content:
The Tianji Record fragment suddenly erupted with dazzling golden light. That grayish-white area began to crack, like a frozen lake welcoming spring breeze.

An aged voice came from the depths of the fragment—that was Mo Xiansheng's voice, yet clearer than ever before: "The fifth page... Fate Writer... are you truly willing to bear this price?"

"Each time you use it... you will permanently lose a portion of your lifespan..."

Chen Ji laughed, laughing maniacally, laughing until his eye corners turned red.

"Permanently consume lifespan?" His voice echoed in his trembling Mental Sea, "Every day I've lived from废物杂役 to today, haven't I been borrowing my life from King Yama?"

He suddenly thrust out his hand, piercing through that cracked grayish-white area, and firmly grabbed the core of the fifth page.

dialogue.content: "My fate, only I myself can write!" Chen Ji's roar shook the entire imperial capital. Mo Xiansheng, far away in the Xuanwu Sect, opened his eyes: "This child... has finally begun to walk his own path."

text.content:
Golden text flooded into Chen Ji's Mental Sea like a flood—that was the complete inheritance of the fifth page of the Tianji Record—"Fate Writer."

This was an ability transcending prophecy. Foreseeing the future was passive endurance, while writing fate was active alteration. Within a certain range, he could forcibly rewrite the endings he had foreseen.

But the price, as Mo Xiansheng had said—each use would permanently burn away a portion of his lifespan.

Chen Ji slowly opened his eyes.

His features seemed to have aged a few years; several strands of white hair had inexplicably appeared at his temples. But his eyes were brighter and sharper than ever before.

Su Qingyao stared at him blankly, her voice slightly trembling: "Chen Ji... your hair..."

"Worth it." Chen Ji lowered his head, looking at his palm, feeling the entirely new power within his body. The corner of his mouth curved into a meaningful arc.

dialogue.content: "From today onward," Chen Ji tucked the Tianji Record fragment into his chest, his gaze sweeping across everyone present, "I am no longer anyone's chess piece. The Tianji Pavilion wants my eyes, the Eyes of Heavenly Dao want my life—let them come try and see if they can take it." He paused, his voice low yet firm, "My fate, only I myself can write."

text.content:
The fifth page of the Tianji Record slowly unfolded within Chen Ji's Mental Sea, golden text intertwined with blood-colored curses. In that moment, the gazes of both surveillance forces simultaneously erupted in rage—the Eyes of Heavenly Dao's vertical pupil abruptly contracted, while the Eyes of the Tianji Pavilion let out a sharp shriek.

But they could not stop it.

The embryonic form of the "Fate Writer" ability had already been seared into the depths of Chen Ji's soul. He did not know how far this power could take him, but he knew that from this moment, the situation on the chessboard had fundamentally changed.

The Tianji Pavilion appointment seven days from now might hold unexpected variables. And all of this was only the beginning.

Above the imperial capital, the night wind suddenly rose.

In the secluded meditation place of the Xuanwu Sect far away, Mo Xiansheng slowly opened his turbid eyes. His gaze penetrated ten thousand li of clouds, seemingly seeing that stubborn figure in the northwestern corner of the imperial capital. The corner of his withered lips slightly curved upward, emitting a soft, almost inaudible sigh: "This child... has finally begun to walk his own path."

The awakening of the fifth page of the Tianji Record alarmed too many dormant existences. The gears of fate have already begun to turn.
